paper.title: Steering Frozen LLMs: Adaptive Social Alignment via Online Prompt Routing

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual multi-objective (utility/safety) clustered linear bandit over a fixed system-prompt pool
unmapped: Two objectives (utility and safety) are observed each round; regret is on the scalarization w_t*u + (1-w_t)*s with an exogenous observed preference weight w_t in [0,1]

Contexts are N prototypes arriving i.i.d. with probabilities p_i, p_min > 0; prototypes are partitioned into M unknown latent clusters sharing parameters (theta^u_j, theta^s_j), separated by gamma in concatenated parameter space
Uniform-arm feature covariance has minimum eigenvalue >= lambda_x
The learner knows p_min, gamma, lambda_x and the number of prototypes N (used to set the exploration prefix T_0 and confidence radii)
Noise is conditionally sigma-sub-Gaussian; rewards in [0,1]
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t$, a prototype $i_t\in\Uset$ arrives i.i.d.\ with $\Pr(i_t=i)=p_i$ ... For each objective $o\in\{u,s\}$, the observed feedback is $y_{t,o} = \mathbf{x}_{a_t}^\top \theta^{o}_{j(i_t)} + \eta_{t,o}$, where $\theta^{o}_{j}\in\R^d$ is an unknown cluster parameter and $(\eta_{t,o})$ is conditionally $\sigma$-sub-Gaussian. Assume $\norm{\mathbf{x}_a}_2\le L$ for all $a$ and $\norm{\theta^{o}_{j}}_2\le 1$ for all $j,o$.

symbols.gamma_sep: separation margin between latent cluster parameters (concatenated utility/safety)
symbols.lambda_x: lower bound on min eigenvalue of uniform-arm feature covariance
symbols.M_clust: number of latent clusters of prototypes

conditions: Assumptions 4.1-4.3: finite fixed arm set with ||x_a|| <= L and lambda_min(E_unif[x x^T]) >= lambda_x; prototypes i.i.d. with p_min > 0; clustered linear realizability with separation gamma
tuning: uniform-exploration prefix of length T_0 as in Lemma H.12

source.label: thm:rccb-main
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions~\ref{assump:finite_arm}, \ref{assump:prototype_process}, and \ref{assump:clustered_linear} hold. Then the cumulative regret of CCLUB satisfies \E[R_T] = O\Bigl(\frac{d}{p_{\min}\gamma^2\lambda_x}\log T + d\sqrt{MT}\log T\Bigr), where the first term captures the cost of cluster identification and the second matches the cluster-level regret.

results.notes: Formal version is Theorem H.15 (same bound; proof shows sigma^2 factor on first term before setting sigma<=1). Regret defined via means mu_t, hence pseudo-regret against per-round best arm. T used in delta=1/T and T_0, so horizon known.

symbols.lambda_x: lower bound on min eigenvalue of uniform-arm feature covariance

tuning: uniform-exploration prefix of length T_0 = max{2048 sigma^2 d/(p_min gamma^2 lambda_x) log(2N/delta), 8/p_min log(N/delta)}
beta_T = sigma*sqrt(2 log(2N/delta) + d log(1+T L^2/(lambda d))) + sqrt(lambda)

source.label: thm:rccb-regret-hp
source.quote: Fix $\delta\in(0,1)$. Under the assumptions above, choose $T_0$ as in Lemma~\ref{lem:rccb-stabilize} and run CCLUB with a uniform-exploration prefix of length $T_0$. Recall $\beta_t \triangleq \beta(t)$. Then with probability at least $1-4\delta$, the cumulative regret is bounded by R_T \le T_0 + 4\beta_T\sqrt{dMT\log\!\bigl(1+TL^2/(\lambda d)\bigr)}.

results.notes: Holds with probability at least 1-4*delta. T_0 and beta_T expanded from Lemma H.12 and the beta(n) definition. Lemma H.6 eigenvalue condition is used implicitly (H.15 proof takes T_0 with an additional 8L^2/lambda_x log(2NdT) term).
